meta.title: Miami POI Map
meta.description: FIFA World Cup related points of interest around Miami.

point_content.name: FIFA Rewards -  FIFA Museum - Miami
point_content.description: Step inside the FIFA Museum in Miami and collect your exclusive Stamp on the FIFA Rewards Map.

point_content.name: FIFA Museum ("Unidad - The World's Game" in Miami)
point_content.description:
“Unidad - The World's Game” in Miami. Freedom Tower. 
The FIFA Museum in Miami is open from Wednesday to Sunday, 10AM - 6PM. 
Closed on Mondays &Tuesdays

point_content.name: OPF Go Rentals at Atlantic Aviation
FIFA Fan Festival Miami
point_content.description: Free FIFA Fan Festival at Bayfront Park, Miami's iconic waterfront park in Downtown. No tickets required. Daily match broadcasts, cultural fan experiences, and F&B reflecting Miami's diversity. First-come, first-served. Jun 13-Jul 5, 2026.

point_content.name: FIFA Store (Dolphin Mall)
point_content.description: Pop-Up and In Line. 11401 NW 12th St, Miami, FL 33172

point_content.name: SpringHill Suites by Marriott Fort Lauderdale Miramar
FIFA Rewards -  Bayside Marketplace
point_content.description: Large waterside shopping center with many familiar stores, plus take-out & sit-down restaurants.

point_content.name: FIFA Rewards -  Little Havana
point_content.description: Little Havana is Miami’s vibrant Cuban heart, with Latin American art galleries and busy restaurants. Cafes with walk-up windows sell Cuban coffee to cigar-smoking patrons. On Calle Ocho (SW 8th Street), locals discuss politics over dominoes at Maximo Gomez Park, dubbed Domino Park by locals. The historic Tower Theater screens independent and revival films, while the area's clubs host live Latin music.

point_content.name: FIFA Rewards -  Miami Beach Boardwalk
point_content.description: Palm-shaded lawns, paths & a playground mark this park that begins the Miami Beach boardwalk.

point_content.name: FIFA Rewards -  Vizcaya Museum and Gardens
point_content.description: Historic estate with formal gardens & sculptures, grottos & circa-1914 mansion turned museum.

point_content.name: FIFA Rewards -  Wynwood Walls
point_content.description: Unique outdoor destination featuring huge, colorful street murals by artists from around the globe.
